description_en: Changes the maintenance window of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyDBClusterMaintainTime接口修改实例可维护时间段
name: ModifyDBClusterMaintainTime

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The maintenance window of the cluster. Specify the maintenance window in the hh:mmZ-hh:mmZ format.

The time range must be 1 hour and start and end at the beginning of an hour
parameters.help_zh:
集群的可维护时间段，格式为hh:mmZ-hh:mmZ。
时间间隔只能为1小时，且需要设置为整点
parameters.name: maintain_time
